name: SN 2016hnk field (Hubble)
blurb: The site of the peculiar Type Ia supernova SN 2016hnk, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2016hnkfield-hubble
story: Hubble came back to the spot where this unusual Type Ia supernova exploded, long after the blast, to measure the radioactive material it made and to study its surroundings.

claims.text: SN 2016hnk is a Type Ia supernova; a later report calls it SN Ia-pec
SN2016HNK is a target of program 16691, late-time imaging of nearby recent transients to measure radioactive material and probe environments
